```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
v24 = load_variables(2024, "acs5")
```

```{r}
tract_geo = get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B01003_001",
  state = "NY",
  county = c(
    "Bronx",
    "Kings",
    "New York",
    "Queens",
    "Richmond"
  ),
  year = 2024,
  geometry = T
)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
saveRDS(tract_geo, "descriptive_gym_analysis/tract_geo.rds")
```
